summary: Frontend-only testing completed for Perfectly Good mobile app. Fixed critical CORS issue blocking all API calls. Core UI flows working: admin/vendor login, home feed with search/filter, drop detail navigation, profile page, dashboard tabs. External API issues (401/404/502 errors) are not frontend bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button triggers alert but doesn't redirect to login screen after confirmation

integration_issues.issue: External API returns 404 for /auth/register endpoint - registration fails with 'HTTP 404' error
integration_issues.note: This is an external API issue, not a frontend bug. The UI correctly displays the error message.

integration_issues.issue: Some authenticated endpoints return 401 (orders, admin vendors) or 502 (vendor drops/orders) errors from external API
integration_issues.note: External API issue. Frontend handles errors gracefully with empty states.

action_items: Investigate logout flow - alert dialog appears but redirect to login screen doesn't happen
External API issues (not frontend bugs): registration endpoint 404, authenticated endpoints returning 401/502
Consider adding retry logic or better error messages for failed API calls
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Removed 'credentials: include' from fetch calls in /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts - was causing CORS errors blocking all API calls
API_BASE is hardcoded in client.ts instead of using environment variable EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL
All React Native components used correctly (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, etc.)
All interactive elements have proper testID attributes for testing
Auth uses Bearer token stored in AsyncStorage - working correctly after CORS fix

success_rate.frontend: 90% - All UI flows working except logout redirect. External API errors are not frontend issues.

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - using external API
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS issue fixed by removing credentials:include. External API has issues (404 on register, 401/502 on some endpoints). Logout redirect needs investigation. All other UI flows working correctly.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of initial login failure: API client was using 'credentials: include' which requires specific CORS headers. External API uses wildcard '*' for Access-Control-Allow-Origin which is incompatible with credentials mode. Fix: Removed credentials:include since app uses Bearer token auth via Authorization header. After fix, login and most features work correctly.
